[14 regression] -ftree-slp-vectorize with -mavx causes incorrect math sincer14-9316-g7890836de20912
Hi, here is the preprocessed .i file for a simple testprogram using no includefiles that adds up 4 numbers and maybe one more:

# 0 "test.c"
# 0 "<built-in>"
# 0 "<command-line>"
# 1 "/usr/include/stdc-predef.h" 1 3 4
# 0 "<command-line>" 2
# 1 "test.c"


int addup(char *num)
{
    int val = num[0]+num[1]+num[2]+num[3];
    if (num[3]>=0) val++;
    return val;
}

int main(int , char *[])
{
    char num[4] = {1,1,1,-1};
    return addup(num);
}


When compiled like this it returns the expected value 2:>gcc -O1 -Wall -Wextra -march=native -o test test.c
>./test; echo $?2


But with extra optimization, the result is different:>gcc -O1 -Wall -Wextra -march=native -ftree-slp-vectorize  -o test test.c
>./test; echo $?3
